description: ModelScope API-Inference is a free, non-commercial serverless inference service for selected open-source text, multimodal, and image-generation models.
residency_notes: The service is hosted at the modelscope.cn China endpoint and is powered by Alibaba Cloud compute. ModelScope does not publish a contractual data-residency or retention commitment for API-Inference.
prompt_training_notes: The API-Inference documentation does not state whether request content may be retained or used for training.
regional_pricing_notes: API-Inference is free of charge and has no published token- or request-based price schedule. It is explicitly non-commercial and does not provide an SLA.

sources.notes: Official API base URLs, authentication, OpenAI-compatible chat and multimodal request formats, beta Anthropic-compatible interface, and asynchronous image-generation interface.

Official free-service terms, Alibaba Cloud account and real-name verification requirements, 2,000-call daily account limit, usual 200-call daily per-model limit, dynamic concurrency, and lifecycle policy.
Unauthenticated live OpenAI-compatible model-list response used for the exact current API-Inference catalogue.

verification.notes: Reconciled against the official live /v1/models response and official API-Inference documentation. IR routing supports OpenAI-compatible text and native asynchronous image editing. This is a free, dynamically limited, non-commercial service without an SLA; no live inference test was performed.
